company.name: Woop AI
company.shortDescription: WOOP provides a digital platform that enables consumer engagement and generates marketing data for brands.
company.description: WOOP operates a digital platform that connects brands with consumers through interactive engagement activities. The platform collects first-party consumer data and supports marketing campaigns by generating user insights and participation. It enables brands to run engagement programs that reward users while contributing to social initiatives such as education and nutrition support. WOOP integrates marketing technology with data collection and social impact initiatives.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $100,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,100,000 to $1,100,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 90 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 78 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
